message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"mip_poll","line":7068,"var":"pkt.ip","code":"mkpay(&pkt, pkt.ip + 1);","note":"The Ethernet frame is parsed as IPv4, and the payload pointer is advanced to the ICMP header supplied by the attacker."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"rx_ip","line":6998,"var":"pkt.icmp","code":"pkt->icmp = (struct icmp *) (pkt->ip + 1);","note":"The IPv4 next-header field selects ICMP, so the packet is reinterpreted as an ICMP message."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"rx_ip","line":6999,"var":"pkt.pay.len","code":"if (pkt->pay.len < sizeof(*pkt->icmp)) return;","note":"The crafted packet includes at least an ICMP header, so processing continues into the vulnerable handler."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"rx_ip","line":7000,"var":"pkt.pay","code":"mkpay(pkt, pkt->icmp + 1);","note":"The payload length is derived from the attacker-controlled raw frame length, preserving the large trailing data for copying."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"rx_icmp","line":6743,"var":"pkt->icmp->type","code":"if (pkt->icmp->type == 8 && pkt->ip->dst == ifp->ip) {","note":"An ICMP echo request to the interface IP satisfies the branch and reaches the transmit path."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"rx_icmp","line":6744,"var":"pkt->pay.len","code":"struct ip *ip = tx_ip(ifp, 1, ifp->ip, pkt->ip->src, sizeof(struct icmp) + pkt->pay.len);","note":"The attacker-controlled payload length is added to the reply size, making the outgoing buffer allocation/copy size depend on the input."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c","function":"rx_icmp","line":6748,"var":"pkt->pay.buf","code":"memcpy(icmp + 1, pkt->pay.buf, pkt->pay.len);","note":"The oversized attacker payload is copied into the transmit buffer, overflowing the fixed-size packet storage and triggering the crash."}
]
JSON
bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json
